notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Canada Lookouts page names this lookout, and it gives only the park, with no date, design or status. The 2018 blog gives the park's 1938-39 tower count but does not name the Dauphin site, so the story does not link those dates to it. Wikipedia names Parks Canada as the park's manager, not necessarily the owner or operator of this tower, so no agency is set. Two WebSearch calls turned up no other Dauphin tower record; two Facebook group posts about old Riding Mountain towers were seen in search but not used as they are unsourced social posts. Record coordinates (50.9683, -100.0633) were not checked against another source. Worth a human check against Parks Canada or Manitoba records before publishing; the short length is the evidence, not a gap in the writing.
